categories.title: Live Tracking & Mapping
categories.summary: See where every vehicle and asset is, right now and in the past.

items.title: Real-time vehicle tracking
items.text: Follow cars, trucks, buses and motorcycles on a live map with speed, heading, ignition status and last update time.

items.title: Live map monitoring
items.text: Switch between street, satellite and hybrid views, group vehicles, and focus on one unit or the whole fleet.

items.title: Route history
items.text: Replay any trip with stops, idle time, speed and distance to verify deliveries and investigate incidents.

items.title: Geofencing
items.text: Draw zones around depots, customers, borders or restricted areas and get alerts when vehicles enter or leave.

categories.title: Smart Alerts & Safety
categories.summary: Instant notifications that help you respond before a problem grows.

items.title: Overspeed alerts
items.text: Set speed limits per vehicle, driver or zone and be notified when they are exceeded.

items.title: Ignition on/off alerts
items.text: Know when engines start or stop, including unauthorised use outside working hours.

items.title: Stop and movement alerts
items.text: Detect long stops, unexpected idling or movement of a vehicle that should be parked.

items.title: Route deviation alerts
items.text: Compare actual paths with planned routes and flag detours or unauthorised trips.

items.title: SOS alerts
items.text: Drivers can trigger a panic or SOS button on supported devices to alert your control team instantly.

items.title: Crash detection
items.text: Where supported by the device, impact and rollover events are reported with location for faster response.

categories.title: Fuel & Maintenance
categories.summary: Control your biggest operating costs and keep vehicles healthy.

items.title: Fuel monitoring
items.text: Track tank level, consumption and refuelling using compatible fuel sensors or CAN data.

items.title: Fuel theft detection
items.text: Receive alerts for sudden fuel drops while parked or in motion, with time and location.

items.title: Engine cut-off support
items.text: On supported devices and wiring, authorised users can immobilise a vehicle to help recover it after theft.

items.title: Maintenance reminders
items.text: Schedule service by distance, engine hours or date so vehicles stay safe and reliable.

categories.title: Driver Management
categories.summary: Know who is driving and how they drive.

items.title: Driver behaviour monitoring
items.text: Score harsh braking, rapid acceleration, sharp cornering and speeding to coach safer driving.

items.title: Driver ID with RFID / iButton
items.text: Identify drivers with a card or key fob so trips, fuel and violations are tied to the right person.

categories.title: Sensors & Cargo Protection
categories.summary: Extend tracking beyond location with connected sensors.

items.title: Temperature monitoring
items.text: Monitor cargo or cabin temperature where supported, with alerts when readings leave safe limits.

items.title: Door sensor monitoring
items.text: Get notified when cargo doors, cabin doors or compartments open outside expected times or places.

categories.title: Reports & Fleet Dashboard
categories.summary: Clear business reporting for owners, managers and auditors.

items.title: Fleet management dashboard
items.text: A single overview of vehicle status, alerts, utilisation, fuel and driver performance.

items.title: Trip reports
items.text: Detailed trip logs with start, end, distance, duration, stops and speed profile.

items.title: Daily, weekly and monthly reports
items.text: Schedule automatic summaries and export them to share with management or customers.

items.title: Business fleet reports
items.text: Utilisation, cost, fuel efficiency, driver ranking and compliance reports tailored to your operation.

categories.title: Vehicle & Asset Types
categories.summary: One platform for every kind of moving asset.

items.title: Truck tracking
items.text: Long-haul and heavy-duty monitoring with fuel, door, temperature and cross-border visibility.

items.title: Car tracking
items.text: Protect company cars, executive vehicles and rental cars with live location and alerts.

items.title: Bus tracking
items.text: Monitor schedules, stops, speed and driver conduct for school, staff and public transport buses.

items.title: Motorcycle tracking
items.text: Compact, tamper-resistant trackers for delivery riders, boda-boda and bike fleets.

items.title: Asset tracking
items.text: Locate trailers, containers, generators and equipment with battery-powered trackers.

categories.title: AI Dashcam & Video Telematics
categories.summary: Add video evidence and AI driver safety to GPS data.

items.title: AI dashcam
items.text: Smart cameras record the road and detect risk events, linking video clips to GPS location and time.

items.title: Front camera and in-cabin camera
items.text: Dual-lens setups capture the road ahead and the driver cabin for complete context.

items.title: Driver distraction detection
items.text: AI recognises when the driver looks away from the road and raises an in-cab and dashboard alert.

items.title: Smoking detection
items.text: Detect smoking behaviour in the cabin to enforce company policy and protect vehicles.

items.title: Phone usage detection
items.text: Identify handheld phone use while driving and record the event as evidence.

items.title: Drowsiness detection
items.text: Spot signs of fatigue such as eye closure and yawning so drivers can be warned before an accident.

items.title: Video telematics
items.text: Request live view or event footage remotely and review incidents alongside speed, route and sensor data.
